title: Molecular signature comprising 11 platelet-genes enables accurate blood-based diagnosis of NSCLC
summary: Machine-learning feature selection on platelet RNA data produced an 11-gene signature, with an independent blood-sample validation distinguishing NSCLC cases from healthy controls; the small validation cohort limits scope.
